description: This file defines a class WebhookOutputMapper that maps Prisma webhook data types to domain-specific Webhook and WebhookSubscriber objects, including methods for conversion and legacy support.

classes.name: WebhookOutputMapper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to map Prisma webhook data types to domain Webhook and WebhookSubscriber objects, including support for list conversions and legacy methods.

methods.name: toWebhook
methods.description: Converts a full PrismaWebhook object to a domain Webhook object for UI and CRUD operations.

methods.name: toWebhookList
methods.description: Converts an array of PrismaWebhookFull objects to an array of Webhook objects.

methods.name: toSubscriber
methods.description: Converts a minimal PrismaWebhook object to a WebhookSubscriber object for delivery.

methods.name: toSubscriberList
methods.description: Converts an array of PrismaWebhookMinimal objects to an array of WebhookSubscriber objects.

methods.name: toDomain
methods.description: Legacy method for backward compatibility, maps PrismaWebhookMinimal to WebhookSubscriber.

methods.name: toDomainList
methods.description: Legacy method for backward compatibility, maps array of PrismaWebhookMinimal to WebhookSubscriber array.

methods.name: toSubscriberPartial
methods.description: Creates a WebhookSubscriber object from a partial PrismaWebhook object with string event triggers and version.
